Hi Avery,

Following up from yesterday’s call — can we schedule a technical deep dive focused on FP8 vs INT8 performance on H100?

What we’re hoping to cover:
- When FP8 helps vs INT8 (prefill vs decode)
- Any known shape/sequence-length caveats
- How Redwood rolls this out safely (canary/rollback)
- Any numbers you can share (even directional) + methodology

Attendees on our side: me + Daniel (ML platform) + potentially procurement.

We’re flexible next week but would prefer Fri 2/21 if possible.

Thanks,
Priya

Works for me.

Guidance on what to share externally:
- OK to share directional guidance + ranges if we anchor to a clear methodology + disclaimers (driver/CUDA pinning, clocks, prompt mix, prefill/decode split).
- Avoid quoting single “best run” numbers. Prefer median + p95 + variance notes.
- For quality: emphasize model- and context-length-dependent deltas; FP8 can be sensitive on long-context for certain families. We can talk about “requires eval sign-off for default enablement” without exposing internal eval data.

If needed, I can prep a 1-slide “quality guardrails” summary and we can keep the rest verbal.

Jonas

Invite sent for Fri 2/21 1:00–1:45pm PT (with recording via Fireflies).

Pre-read (lightweight):
- One-pager on benchmarking methodology + what we control for (warmups, clocks, driver/CUDA pinning, prompt mixes).
- A short summary of how we think about FP8 vs INT8 selection (by workload + shape regime) and how we rollout safely.

For the call, we’ll focus on:
- Your prompt-length distribution + output lengths (decode-heavy vs prefill-heavy)
- Concurrency expectations + latency SLOs (p50/p95)
- What “success” looks like for a small pilot benchmark (we can provide scripts + runbook)

If you have any representative ranges (input/output tokens, QPS, streaming vs non-streaming), feel free to email ahead of time.

Attachment: SummitAI_Fp8Int8_DeepDive.ics

—
Markus Klein
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Confidentiality note: We’ll keep any performance numbers tied to a clearly stated methodology and environment. Final claims (if any) can be shared after we align on caveats + data scope.
